name: ReferenceCandidateMatching

normalization_profile.casefold_provider: repository-versioned full Unicode CaseFolding mapping generated from Unicode 17.0.0 CaseFolding.txt
normalization_profile.runtime_rule: Python built-in unicodedata version, str.casefold() and str.isspace() are not authority for matching because supported Python lines may ship different Unicode databases
normalization_profile.asset_rule: generated CaseFolding/White_Space assets are source-controlled implementation assets with recorded Unicode source version/checksum and deterministic regeneration test; changing the profile/version requires an accepted migration/reindex plan for stored match keys
normalization_profile.packaging_rule: LLD-12 must include required third-party attribution/license notice for unicodedata2 without changing SOMA proprietary product ownership

steps: reject non-string input and enforce pre-normalization semantic byte bound
apply Unicode NFKC compatibility normalization through UNICODE_MATCH_V1 NFKC provider
replace each maximal run of code points in the UNICODE_MATCH_V1 White_Space set, including surrounding whitespace, with one ASCII U+0020 space, then remove leading/trailing separator
do not strip or rewrite punctuation
enforce post-normalization key bound and reject empty normalized result
normalizer.determinism: the same UNICODE_MATCH_V1 vector corpus must produce byte-identical UTF-8 keys on Python 3.13 and 3.14; runtime Unicode database changes cannot alter the result
prohibitions: no direct Python-runtime Unicode tables as unversioned authority

customer_org_match.rule: UNIQUE_CANDIDATE remains candidate evidence and does not by itself authorize merge/reassignment

contact_match.scope: exactly one of customer_org_id or UNBOUND
contact_match.email_key: active contact_channels where channel_kind='email' using match_key
contact_match.customer_scope_query: candidate Contact must have is_current=1 affiliation to the supplied customer_org_id
contact_match.unbound_scope_query: candidate Contact must have no is_current=1 affiliation row
contact_match.candidate_union: union candidate IDs from supplied governed keys; repeated evidence for the same Contact collapses to one candidate ID; distinct Contacts produced by different exact supplied keys remain AMBIGUOUS rather than allowing one key to silently outrank another
contact_match.rule: equal normalized email in different Customer scopes is not a global identity collision; equal keys within one scope may remain ambiguous

stored_key_versioning.rule: every persisted match_key column is paired logically with the installation's accepted matching profile UNICODE_MATCH_V1; startup schema/application compatibility verifies the supported profile before matching writes/queries
stored_key_versioning.upgrade: a future profile change is not an in-place reinterpretation: it requires a governed forward migration that recomputes all affected keys transactionally and proves candidate behavior before publication

write_time_key_rule: Every accepted write that changes a matched descriptive/channel value computes the match key with this same profile inside application validation before persistence; repositories reject missing/inconsistent derived key input.
review_rule: A matcher has no write capability. Selection/link/merge/reassignment is performed only by a separate owning command after operator/reconciliation authority and fresh state revalidation.
